editorial:
Imagine finding out a giant volcano is about to explode right under your city, but nobody believes you. That is exactly what happens to Clive, a scientist who spots some scary seismic activity in the Gulf of Waitemata. He tries to warn everyone, but his colleagues think he has lost his mind. To make things worse, his own wife is more worried about the company's stock price and investors than she is about the actual lava. It feels like a race against time where the hero is fighting both nature and the people who should be helping him.

The movie keeps things moving quickly and does a great job of building tension. While the special effects are a bit dated, the drama between the husband and wife adds a nice layer of stress to the plot. If you enjoy disaster flicks where the expert is ignored until the last second, you will have a blast with this one.
endingExplained: In the final act, the volcano finally erupts just like Clive predicted. All the people who called him crazy are forced to face the disaster. There is a lot of chaos as the city deals with the lava and ash. Clive manages to save some people, and his wife finally realizes that her greed was a mistake. The movie wraps up with the city in ruins, but Clive is proven right and survives the blast.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves disaster movies and underdog stories.
